title: Bunting for the Fair

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Tomorrow's the fair! The whole square must be strung with bunting.

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Will you hang the flags in a pattern? Everyone likes a pattern.

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: Carry on the pattern of flags. What comes next?

older.prompt: Carry on the pattern: red, green, green, yellow, blue. What comes next?

feedback.all_good: The square looks ready for a party!

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Look at it flutter! Tomorrow, the whole city will dance under it.

journal_line: I hung bunting for the Bellhaven fair with Mrs. Greta.
